rationale: DLTR has gapped up 7.8% on 3.2x relative volume, which is a significant catalyst-driven move, but the price action shows extreme volatility in the first two 1-minute candles (range from $147.83 to $151.33) with the last print at $152.50 sitting at the top of today's range (position 100%) and well above the session VWAP of $149.68 and 9-EMA of $150.03. The wide bid-ask spread of 65.6 bps adds friction, and with SPY down 1.31% and VIXY up 4.74% indicating a risk-off environment, chasing a gap-up at the high of range in a weak tape carries unfavorable risk/reward in both directions — a long risks a gap fade while a short risks continuation of a strong earnings/news catalyst. Insufficient price structure has formed to define a clean entry with acceptable invalidation levels.
